subject: Scope of onboarding evidence & temporary invoice-only lane for Nimbus DataWorks
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbusdata.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@nimbusdata.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Quick question on onboarding evidence / PO requirement

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick call earlier. To recap — our finance team is asking whether Redwood can accept invoices from Nimbus DataWorks for the pilot period without a Purchase Order on file. We understand there is a standard PO requirement, but this is a short trial (estimated spend <$6k).

Can you confirm the minimum evidence you need to create a temporary invoice-only onboarding (if any)? Specific asks from our side:
- What forms do you need filled?
- Any SLA or insurance evidentiary items we must supply?
- How long can an invoice-only path remain open before a PO is required?

We have internal constraints and would prefer not to wait for a full PO workflow this week. Attaching our onboarding packet for context (see attachment: nimbus_onboarding_packet.pdf).

Would appreciate a short list we can send to our AP team.

Best,
Elena
Senior Partnerships Manager
Nimbus DataWorks

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbusdata.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-28T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on onboarding evidence / PO requirement

Hi Elena — thanks for the packet. Short answer: yes, we can provisionally accept invoices for small pilots via an invoice-only lane while the PO is being processed, but we need a minimal evidence package and an internal approval (exception ladder).

High-level requirements for a temporary invoice-only onboarding (pilot < $10k):
1) Completed onboarding form (standard supplier intake) — we can accept a scanned PDF.
2) W9 (US) or equivalent tax form / VAT registration for EU vendors.
3) Proof of business insurance (certificate) if services involve access to customer data. For trials without data access, insurance can be delayed by exception approval.
4) Signed MSA or a stub indicating MSA negotiation is in progress; DocuSign link acceptable.
5) Point of contact in AP with invoice routing email and expected payment terms.

Operational notes: the invoice-only lane is timeboxed at 60 days by default; extension requires a manager sign-off (Naomi will approve extensions). We also require a manual flag in ProcureOps with Deal ID (please reference DEAL-78934).

Attachments: I’m including a provisional invoice template as XLSX for your AP team to use (provisional_invoice-template.xlsx).

Next steps: Elena — if you can send the three items above (intake form, tax doc, AP contact) I’ll route for a provisional approval. Naomi / Vanessa — I’ve cc’d you for compliance and procurement ops sign-off.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Vendor Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbusdata.com>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@vendorlegal.co>
Date: 2027-03-01T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on onboarding evidence / PO requirement

Markus / Elena — a couple of compliance clarifications from my side before I authorize a 60-day invoice-only lane:

- Insurance: if Nimbus will be sending any telemetry/samples from a production environment we need a certificate of insurance listing Redwood as an additional insured. If it's strictly trial data generated by their environment (no customer PII), we can accept certification that no PII will be exchanged and defer the COI for 30 days.
- Security questionnaire: for trials that include model integration we ask for a short security questionnaire (we can use the 5-question short form) — I can send the form or accept a vendor-supplied assessment.
- Evidence retention policy: procurement requires that a copy of the intake form + tax doc be stored in our vendor folder (Drive link below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNimbusOnboard
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-78934

If Elena can drop the intake form + tax doc into the Drive and confirm the AP contact, I will run the exception ladder. Tom (vendorlegal) — please confirm that the stub MSA Elena referenced is acceptable as "evidence of MSA in-progress" for a provisional approval.

Naomi Feldman
Procurement & Vendor Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — summary and approval below. Elena, consider this our provisional exception approval for the Nimbus pilot (DEAL-78934) with the following conditions: 

1) Required to receive approval (to be uploaded to the Drive before first invoice):
   - Completed supplier intake form (uploaded).
   - W9 (or VAT reg) (uploaded).
   - AP point of contact + invoice routing email.
   - Signed stub MSA or DocuSign envelope indicating MSA negotiation in progress (signed_msa_stub.pdf attached).
2) Conditions while invoice-only lane is active (60 day default):
   - No production customer PII shared. If that changes, suspend the lane and provide COI immediately.
   - Security short-form to be returned within 14 days of lane activation. Naomi will monitor.
   - One-time cap at $10k; any spend beyond requires PO or executive exemption.
3) Administration & next steps:
   - Vanessa: please add the vendor to ProcureOps with a temporary "invoice-only" flag and link to Drive evidence.
   - Naomi: I have documented the exception ladder and will sign the 60-day approval. If Nimbus needs extension, escalate to Finance for a 30-day extension review.
   - Elena: once evidence is uploaded, ping me and I’ll finalize the flag.

Attachments included for their records: provisional_invoice-template.xlsx, signed_msa_stub.pdf.

Markus Klein
Head of Vendor Programs
Redwood Inference
